csv_edition.hash_basis: Observed bytes of the publisher's v49 release copy. This is not a claim that a fresh live download has identical bytes; the checker reports the bytes it actually reads.

primary_source.title: Counts of Australian Businesses, including Entries and Exits
primary_source.verification_method: Read stored numeric cells from original XLSX XML using Python zipfile and ElementTree, resolving workbook relationships and shared strings. No workbook edit or export. This manual source-cell verification is distinct from the CSV arithmetic checker included here.

interpretation.population: The 2022-23 entry cohort in the ABS actively trading market-sector business framework; not all ABN holders or only small businesses.
interpretation.overlap: Industry, state and employment are separate views of the same cohort. Employment includes a subtotal and total. Do not sum across these rows.
interpretation.scope: Continued statistical activity does not establish profit, insolvency, causal effects of staffing or future survival probability.
interpretation.rights: Source rights remain with their holders under applicable terms. No blanket reuse licence is asserted. No source data files are included.
